description: January 19 birthday meaning: Capricorn or Aquarius cusp, birthday number 1, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, January 19 is a cusp birthday: depending on the year, time and place of birth, the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius. In numerology the day gives birthday number 1, while the Life Path also depends on the birth year. Many people born on cusp dates recognise something of both signs.

sections.heading: The January 19 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Is a January 19 birthday Capricorn or Aquarius? That hangs on the year and the hour, since the Sun crosses into Aquarius around now and usually still sits in the last degrees of Capricorn. The blend reads as structure meeting originality, and the birthday number 1, from 19, adds a streak of independence to either side.

Astronomically, January 19 puts the Sun near 28° Capricorn in most years, inside the third ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Mercury. Around January 19 to January 21 the Sun moves from Capricorn into Aquarius, and people born near that border often feel pulled between tradition and reinvention. The exact crossing shifts from year to year, so your Sun sign depends on the year, the time and the place of birth; a calculated chart is the only firm answer. The blend is frequently described as a practical reformer: someone with Capricorn's patience and respect for structure who also carries Aquarius' independent, future-facing streak, wanting to change the system and to do it properly.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for January 19
paragraphs: Born on the 19th, the compound 1 + 9 makes 10, which reduces to 1. The birthday number is therefore 1, reached through the full span of the single digits from first to last. Numerologists sometimes call 19 a karmic debt number associated with learning to accept help. People born on this day are frequently described as fiercely independent, resourceful and determined to do things their own way. The 9 in the compound adds compassion and a broad outlook to the 1's drive. As a secondary number, it tends to reward asking for support without seeing it as weakness.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a January 19 birthday gives Life Path 3 for 1990, 4 for 2000, 5 for 2010 and 6 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous January 19 birthdays
paragraphs: A January birthday arrives in the depths of northern winter, a season of short days, stock-taking and fresh resolutions; south of the equator it falls in high summer instead. Most of the month belongs to Capricorn, with Aquarius taking over around January 20. In numerology January is month 1, the number of beginnings and self-direction, which suits a birthday that sits right at the start of the calendar. January 19 is the 19th day of the year. Counting forward, the next sign change, into Aquarius, is usually complete within 2 days, by January 21.

In the Chinese zodiac a January 19 birth comes before the new year has turned, so the animal is the one that began the previous winter. Among the best-known people with a January 19 birthday are Edgar Allan Poe (1809), James Watt (1736) and Paul Cézanne (1839).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is January 19?
faq.answer: January 19 is a cusp date. Between 1930 and 2030 the Sun is in Capricorn or Aquarius on this date depending on the year, the time of birth and the time zone, and in most years at noon UTC it is in Capricorn. The zodiac sign calculator settles it for a specific birth date.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on January 19?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On January 19 the Life Path is 9 in 1960, 1 in 1970, 11 in 1980, 3 in 1990, 4 in 2000, 5 in 2010 and 6 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 1 for everyone born on the 19th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on January 19?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, January 19 always falls before Lunar New Year, which arrives between January 21 and February 20, so someone born on this date takes the animal of the previous calendar year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on January 19?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on January 19 include Edgar Allan Poe (1809), James Watt (1736) and Paul Cézanne (1839). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
